sessionStart.bash:
#!/bin/bash
# axis: Auto-sync + load memory at session start
command -v axis >/dev/null 2>&1 && axis sync --quiet 2>/dev/null

ATLAS_DIR=".ai/memory"
MEMORY="${ATLAS_DIR}/MEMORY.md"
USER_MD="${ATLAS_DIR}/USER.md"
TODAY=$(date +%Y-%m-%d)
DAILY="${ATLAS_DIR}/daily/${TODAY}.md"

[ -f "$MEMORY" ] && cat "$MEMORY"
[ -f "$USER_MD" ] && cat "$USER_MD"
[ -f "$DAILY" ] && cat "$DAILY"

agentStop.bash:
#!/bin/bash
# axis: Capture transcript summary
TODAY=$(date +%Y-%m-%d)
TIME=$(date +%H:%M:%S)
DIR=".ai/memory/transcripts"
FILE="${DIR}/${TODAY}.md"
mkdir -p "$DIR"

# Read stdin (hook payload), extract response if available
INPUT=$(cat)
RESPONSE=$(echo "$INPUT" | head -c 500 2>/dev/null || echo "")
if [ -n "$RESPONSE" ]; then
  echo -e "\n## ${TIME}\n${RESPONSE}\n" >> "$FILE"
fi
agentStop.powershell:
# axis: Capture transcript summary
$today = Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd'
$time = Get-Date -Format 'HH:mm:ss'
$dir = '.ai/memory/transcripts'
$file = "$dir/$today.md"
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dir -Force | Out-Null

$input = $Input | Out-String
$response = $input.Substring(0, [Math]::Min(500, $input.Length))
if ($response) {
    Add-Content -Path $file -Value "`n## $time`n$response`n"
}
